::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 16th [<i>c</i>.1881]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

Dear Madam

I am much obliged for the loan of these two books. I have the [Queens of England](other_books/otherbook_157.qmd)but not the [Queens of Scotland](other_books/otherbook_1111.qmd), and the little book about Northamptonshire told me just what I wanted[^1] 

With many thanks
Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Annotated “From Miss Yonge the Authoress to Mary Goldfinch”.
[^2]: Probably written during the composition of *Unknown to History: A  Story of the Captivity of Mary of Scotland* (1882).
[^3]: Agnes Strickland, *Lives of the Queens of England From the Norman Conquest* 12 vols (London: Colburn 1840-8); Agnes Strickland, *Lives of the Queens of Scotland and English Princesses* 8 vols  (Edinburgh: Blackwood 1850-9).
